description: The specified reverse-order composite translation preserves satisfaction between every final structure satisfying all stages of a finite definition chain and its fixed initial reduct.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.tower_elimination.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {K : ℕ → FirstOrder.Language}
  (d :
    (i : ℕ) →
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerLanguage L K i) (K i))
  (n : ℕ) {α : Type z} (A : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerLanguage L K n).Formula α)
  (M : Type w) [s : L.Structure M]
  (S : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerLanguage L K n).Structure M)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.TowerExpansion d M n S) (v : α → M) :
  A.Realize v ↔ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerTranslate d n A).Realize v
